exposure: Characteristics of medical staff (kindness, support, understanding, expertise)
outcome: Suggestions for improvements in maternity care
cohort: The study included 341 women in Croatia who had given birth within the previous five years.
finding: The most frequently described positive childbirth experiences were related to the birth environment, characteristics of medical staff, general quality of care, contact with babies, and support for breastfeeding, while needed changes focused on objective characteristics of the birth environment, facilitation of natural childbirth, and provision of support.
cross-section timing: Data was collected from women regarding births that occurred within the previous five years before their participation in the online survey.
